rows.grounds: fused sandhi form: yatra + eva + ādi + iṣṭakā + nyāsam; accusative object indicating location of initial brick-laying
fused sandhi form: tatra + garbham; adverb plus accusative object referring to the embryo receptacle
causative verb from ni-dhā, prescribing the ritual action

items.question: At what location must the embryo deposit be placed during the ritual foundation?
premises: The initial brick placement establishes a specific ritual location.
The embryo deposit is a prescribed ritual element in construction.
The prescribed action is to deposit the embryo at that same location.
items.inference: Therefore, the embryo deposit must be placed exactly where the first brick was laid.
uncertainties: The precise material nature of the garbha in this specific ritual context is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Wherever the first brick is laid, there one should deposit the embryo.
